findings.codeql_raw_query:
/**
 * @name Command injection via subprocess
 * @description Using subprocess with user-controlled input without proper validation can lead to command injection
 * @kind path-problem
 * @problem.severity error
 * @id py/command-injection
 * @tags security
 *        external/cwe/cwe-078
 */

import python
import semmle.python.dataflow.new.DataFlow
import semmle.python.dataflow.new.TaintTracking
import semmle.python.dataflow.new.RemoteFlowSources
import semmle.python.Concepts
import semmle.python.ApiGraphs

module CommandInjectionConfig implements DataFlow::ConfigSig {
  predicate isSource(DataFlow::Node source) {
    source instanceof RemoteFlowSource or
    source.asExpr().(Name).getId() in ["argv"] or
    exists(Attribute attr |
      attr.getObject().(Name).getId() = "sys" and
      attr.getName() = "argv" and
      source.asExpr() = attr
    )
  }

  predicate isSink(DataFlow::Node sink) {
    sink = any(SystemCommandExecution cmd).getCommand()
  }
}

module CommandInjectionFlow = TaintTracking::Global<CommandInjectionConfig>;
import CommandInjectionFlow::PathGraph

from CommandInjectionFlow::PathNode source, CommandInjectionFlow::PathNode sink
where CommandInjectionFlow::flowPath(source, sink)
select sink.getNode(), source, sink, "Command injection from $@.", source.getNode(), "user input"
findings.hypothesis: Detecting command injection vulnerabilities where user-controlled input flows to subprocess execution

findings.codeql_raw_query:
/**
 * @name Unverified URL download
 * @description Downloading content from URLs without proper validation or using HTTP instead of HTTPS
 * @kind problem
 * @problem.severity warning
 * @id py/unverified-download
 * @tags security
 *        external/cwe/cwe-494
 */

import python
import semmle.python.ApiGraphs

from DataFlow::CallCfgNode call
where
  (
    call = API::moduleImport("urllib").getMember("request").getMember(["urlopen", "urlretrieve"]).getACall() or
    call = API::moduleImport("urllib").getMember(["urlopen", "urlretrieve"]).getACall() or
    call = API::moduleImport("requests").getMember(["get", "post", "request"]).getACall()
  ) and
  exists(StrConst url |
    url = call.getArg(0).asExpr() and
    url.getText().matches("http://%")
  )
select call, "Potential insecure HTTP download instead of HTTPS."
findings.hypothesis: Check for insecure HTTP downloads that should use HTTPS

findings.codeql_raw_query:
/**
 * @name TOCTOU race condition in file operations
 * @description Checking file existence before operating on it can lead to race conditions
 * @kind problem
 * @problem.severity warning
 * @id py/toctou-race-condition
 * @tags security
 *        external/cwe/cwe-367
 */

import python
import semmle.python.ApiGraphs

from DataFlow::CallCfgNode check_call, DataFlow::CallCfgNode op_call
where
  (
    check_call = API::moduleImport("os").getMember("path").getMember(["exists", "isfile", "isdir"]).getACall() or
    check_call = API::moduleImport("pathlib").getMember("Path").getReturn().getMember(["exists", "is_file", "is_dir"]).getACall()
  ) and
  (
    op_call = API::moduleImport("os").getMember(["remove", "unlink", "rmdir", "rename"]).getACall() or
    op_call = API::moduleImport("shutil").getMember(["rmtree", "move", "copy", "copy2"]).getACall() or
    op_call = API::builtin("open").getACall()
  ) and
  check_call.getLocation().getFile() = op_call.getLocation().getFile()
select check_call, "Potential TOCTOU race condition: file check followed by operation at $@.", op_call.getLocation(), "this location"
findings.hypothesis: TOCTOU race conditions where file existence is checked before operations
